name: Finding A Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that finding a wife is a divine provision and blessing from the LORD, designed to meet the man's need for companionship as God declared it was not good for man to be alone (Genesis 2:18). A virtuous and prudent wife is portrayed as a crown and a gift from God, bringing honor and favor to her husband (Proverbs 12:4; Proverbs 19:14). Trusting in the LORD and delighting in Him are essential, as He grants the desires of the heart, including the blessing of a godly spouse (Psalms 37:4; Proverbs 3:5). Thus, finding a wife is not merely a human endeavor but one deeply rooted in dependence on God's wisdom and provision (Proverbs 18:22).
